title: BioScience: connecting the community for 75 years
content: We were remiss to not mention in our January editorial, “Government and public confidence in science” (https://doi.org/10.1093/biosci/biae137), that we embark on our 75th year of publishing BioScience, including the preceding years when volumes 1–14 were published as the AIBS Bulletin. I find the sentiments of Hallmark cards to typically be on point, and a 75th anniversary card might emphasize the wisdom and countless activities that the celebrant has conferred on their associates. Therefore, it is striking to compare the contents across years that manifest the commitment of AIBS to its member societies. Just as we articulated in the December 2024 editorial, “Déjà vu all over again (Yogi Berra)” (https://doi.org/10.1093/biosci/biae128), the first editorial in volume 1, issue 1, “Across the editor's desk” (https://doi.org/10.1093/aibsbulletin/1.1.4), highlighted the role of AIBS to link the various biological disciplines to increase synergy for future research and teaching activities, as well as in giving greater voice to a unified biological community.
